key_insight: QuTuner tunes quantum compiler optimization passes using both circuit structure and optimization-response signals to find better pass sequences faster across different compilers.
engineering_relevance: This can help quantum software engineers reduce circuit cost and improve execution fidelity while cutting the time spent searching for effective compiler settings.
method: Builds a large optimization dataset from compiled quantum circuits.
Represents each circuit with static circuit features plus optimization-aware pass embeddings.
Uses two offline models to retrieve, rank, and lightly refine candidate pass sequences for unseen circuits.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on Qiskit and PyTKET benchmarks, QuTuner achieved up to 84.85% better metric reduction and 73.59% lower tuning time on Qiskit, and up to 18.68% better metric reduction with 64.49% less tuning time on PyTKET.
watch_item: The approach depends on a large prebuilt optimization dataset and offline model training, so performance may vary when compiler passes, hardware targets, or circuit distributions differ from the training data.
paper_title: QuTuner: Feature- and Learning-Guided Optimization Pass Tuning for Quantum Compilers
